pages.title: Crocus Clam
pages.text: The boring clam ($(o)Tridacna crocea$()) is the smallest giant clam, found on the shallow coral reefs of the Indo-Pacific.$(br2)Its shell is rarely more than 15 centimetres long, and its fleshy mantle is brilliant blue, green, gold or brown, often patterned with spots and streaks.$(br2)It grinds its way into coral heads until only the colourful mantle shows. Algae living in the mantle feed it with sugars made from sunlight.
